name: Sacred Rites
summary: Each Adepta Sororitas unit in this detachment can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase instead of one.

name: Fervent Purgation
summary: Ranged weapons on Adepta Sororitas models gain the Assault ability, and attacks against a target within 6" get +1 Strength.

name: Righteous Purpose
summary: Up to 3 Adepta Sororitas units become Righteous each Command phase: +1" Move, +1 Ld, and +1 WS/BS on Battle Sisters Squad, Celestian Sacresants and Paragon Warsuits weapons. Separately, unshocked Celestian Sacresants have +1 OC.

name: Angelic Judgement
summary: Adepta Sororitas Infantry Fly units gain: in your Shooting phase, mark one visible enemy unit within 12" as condemned, giving that unit +3" detection range.

name: The Blood of Martyrs
summary: Attacks by an Adepta Sororitas model get +1 to hit if its unit is below starting strength, and also +1 to wound if that unit is below half-strength.

name: Desperate for Redemption
summary: Each battle round pick one unused Vow of Atonement: Penitent models get +3" Move; or Penitent melee weapons get +1 Attacks/Strength in a unit that charged; or a Penitent destroyed in melee before fighting strikes back on 2+.

name: Hymns of Battle
summary: This detachment's Enhancements don't count toward your army's enhancement limit, and Adepta Sororitas Character units get +1 Leadership.
